title: Nayrïr Almaw Sayt’asi
intro: Janïr khiti yatiyirix aka Uraqin sarnaqkipanxa, janïr kuna qillqatas uñstkipanxa, mä jaqiw uñstawayi, janiw yaqha jaqir uñtaskiti. Aka almax Diosan amparanakapamp luratawa, mä chiqaw jan uñtasit suma uñnaqt’ani, ukat yant’ata, ukhamat jaqinakan sarnaqäwipanx ist’asiñapataki. Kunatï uka qhepat paskäna ukajja, jan chʼamanïñata, taqe chuyma arrepentisiñata ukat mä destinowa, ukajj wiñayatakiw luratanakan sarnaqäwip mayjtʼayani. ¿Khitis akax uk amuytʼasmati?
clues: Nayax khuyapayasir Diosan amparapampiw uraq laq’at uñstayatäyäta
Nayarojj jan uñtasit suma uñnaqtʼan uta churapjjetäna, ukanjja janiw manqʼat awtjatäñasa ni qarjatäñas llamktʼkitänti
Janipuniw mä quqarus jakʼachasiñax wakiskiti, kunattix jarkʼatänwa
Nayampi masijampixa sallqjata, jark’at quqaru jak’achasipxta, Tatitusan kamachiparjama
Taqi chuyma arrepentisisaw Tatitusar kuttʼxapxta, ukat juchanakasat pampachatäpxaraktwa
Jiwasatw taqi jaqinakax jutapxi; Nayaw nayrïr kutix aka uraqin sarnaqirïta

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Jaqinakar nayrïr uñjirjamaw aka uraqir khithatänxa
Faraonasa, ejercitopampejj lamar qotan umamp chhaqtjjapjjäna
Jachʼa umajj jan wali jaqenakaruw tukjäna
outcome.answer: Jaqinakar nayrïr uñjirjamaw aka uraqir khithatänxa

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
